headline: Wabtec reports rising earnings on higher freight and transit sales
summary: Wabtec Corporation reported an increase in earnings driven by higher sales across its freight and transit segments.
why: Wabtec is a major global provider of equipment, systems, and services for the freight rail and passenger transit industries.

impacts.name: Wabtec Corp
impacts.why: Higher segment sales directly translate to improved top-line revenue growth and quarterly earnings.
